display_name: 时频跨恢复网络源域响应梯度
description: 使用与在训模型相同种子的全新初始化，比较源波形误差与四类合成微扰响应的输出头梯度，不加载在训状态。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 CPU, two threads, CUDA hidden; source-only fixed evaluation

data.version: 32 previously explored source pilot records, 8 per each of four fixed RX/view groups
data.representation: paired source IQ and synthetic 1% RMS clean perturbations through DURA estimated action
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: First eight records in RX4/6 and RX8, practical_high and practical_low_urban; pilot disjoint from direct fit

roles.L_s: source IQ only, transmitter truth not read
roles.U_s: source IQ only, transmitter truth hidden

data.validation_ref: Frozen DURA real-source smoke and finite source waveform metrics
data.leo_config_ref: fixed source epoch19 seven simulated views

permissions.claim_scope: Source output-head gradients at fresh initialization only; no trained-checkpoint, identity or target claim

checkpoint.initialization: Fresh CrossExpertRefiner initialized with 2026110830; frozen DURA and direct source final20
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Direct source final20 fit disjoint from fixed source pilot; no in-flight training state loaded
checkpoint.selection_rule: One fixed initialization and 32 source records; no updates or checkpoint saved

notes: Source-only fresh initialization, frozen DURA/direct; no F/TX/V/target or model updates.
Four 1% RMS clean perturbations injected through original estimated DURA action; re-estimate on perturbed IQ.
Gradient geometry is calculated for the time and frequency output heads only, averaged equally across four groups; alpha .01 is a reference, not a chosen training coefficient.
Nine focused tests and one independent P0/P1 review passed; real-source checkpoint and initial-output smoke first.
Synthetic source response and initial gradients do not establish target identity performance or trained-model behavior.
